_comment: Content Fragment Model for the Price Archaeology price database (docs/DECISIONS.md D6).
Field shapes follow the Content Fragment Model contract read from the live AEM spec via
lookup-api-spec (GET/POST /adobe/sites/cf/models). Create this model FIRST — every fragment
in price-pairs/ references its returned model id.
Why this model and not a flat table: every price on this channel must carry two independent
sources with at least one primary (docs/05-compliance.md Rule 2). A structured model enforces
that at the schema level, so an under-sourced pair cannot be authored at all — the same
guarantee gate check C2 makes in the video pipeline, extended to the public database.
title: Price Pair
description: One verified anchor-year vs current-year price for a single named product, with its sources. The atomic record of the Price Archaeology database.

fields.name: slug
fields.description: Episode slug this pair aired in, e.g. four-k-tv

fields.name: productName
fields.description: The exact named model. Never a category — 'VIZIO SmartCast 55" E-Series Ultra HD (E55u-D0)', not 'a TV'.

fields.name: category
fields.description: Grouping for the public index, e.g. televisions

fields.name: tier
fields.description: Tier must match across both years or the comparison is not like-for-like

fields.name: anchorPriceKind
fields.description: The MSRP-vs-street asterisk, made structural. Episode 001's anchor is manufacturer-msrp and the video says so out loud.

fields.name: anchorPriceAdjusted
fields.description: Anchor price in current-year dollars. Deflator series recorded in inflationSeriesId.

fields.name: qualityAdjustedSeriesId
fields.description: The independent cross-check, e.g. BLS CUUR0000SERA01

fields.name: sourcesJson
fields.description: REQUIRED. JSON array of {url, kind, publisher, quote, accessed}. Must contain >= 2 entries with >= 1 kind:'primary' — docs/05-compliance.md Rule 2. An under-sourced pair must never be authored.

fields.name: caveat
fields.description: The disclosed asterisk, stated not smoothed. Episode 001: anchor is a launch MSRP, current is a shelf price.

fields.name: airedAt
fields.description: Only aired pairs are published — publishing what already appeared on screen leaks nothing (D6).
